Dear Sir/Madam, This refers to the  Object of the Issue  as mentioned in the Explanatory Statement to Notice of AGM dated September 6, 2025 and the subsequent Corrigendum there to dated September 18, 2025 issued as per the direction of National Stock Exchange of India Limited.In connection with the same, as directed by NSE, minor amendments have been made to the  4th paragraph under point (b) Capital Expenditure requirements towards renovation/ completion of existing properties of the Hotel Complex in Celebrity Resort, Shamirpet, Hyderabad   Rs. 8,23,46,206/- under Item 5 Object of the Issue  as mentioned in Corrigendum dated September 18, 2025 to the Annual General Meeting Notice.The said paragraph shall be read as follows:  The company may, in case there is no immediate requirement but funds being made available from the aforesaid Preferential issue, invest and hold the same in short term deposits, bonds, liquid funds, debt mutual funds and other such similar instruments and withdraw as and when required to meet project specific expenditure as per the applicable laws. (Amendment duly highlighted in bold and underline)The above is for information of all the stakeholders of the Company.This disclosure is being made under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, in the interest of transparency and to keep the stakeholders appropriately informed.
